HAQ-DEMO01.replyText:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main ne aap ka masla samajh liya hai. Yeh **Taleem aur University ke Masail (Degree / Documents)** ke zumray mein aata hai.

### ⚖️ Aap ke Qanooni aur Aaeeni Haqooq:
- **Article 25A – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right to Education):** Har shehri ko taleem hasil karne aur apni taleemi asnaad (documents) par qanooni haq deta hai.
- **Article 4 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right of Individuals to be Dealt with in Accordance with Law):** Koi bhi idara ya university qanooni jawaz ke baghair aap ke original documents ya degree nahi rok sakti.
- **Article 18 & Article 199 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Freedom of Profession & High Court Writ Jurisdiction):** Degree ya original asnaad rokna aap ke rozgar ke haq (Art. 18) ki khilaf warzi hai aur High Court (Art. 199) mein challenge ho sakta hai.

### 📜 Laago Qanoon (Pakistani Law):
- **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Ordinance, 2002 (Section 10 (Powers and Functions of the Commission) & HEC Student Grievance Directives):** HEC Ordinance 2002 aur HEC directives ke mutabiq koi bhi university student ke original documents (Matric/Inter certificates) apne paas nahi rakh sakti aur clearance ke baad degree ya transcript rokna qanoonan mana hai.
- **Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (Article 9 (Jurisdiction, Functions and Powers)):** Sarkari university ya idaray ki taraf se degree ya documents dene mein bila-jawaz takheer 'Bad-Intizami' (Maladministration) hai jis par Wafaqi Mohtasib 60 din mein faisla karta hai.

### 🏛️ Mutaliqa Idara (Relevant Authority):
- **Higher Education Commission (HEC) – Student Grievance Portal**
- Official Portal: https://onlinehelp.hec.gov.pk
- Helpline: 051-111-119-432

### ✅ Aap ke paas 2 Aasaan Options hain:
1. **Option 1 – Online Complaint Submit Karein (Edit & 1-Click Forward):** Hum ne aap ki formal complaint tayyar kar di hai. Aap usay check/edit kar ke **1-Click** mein seedha **HEC Pakistan** ko forward kar sakte hain.
2. **Option 2 – Mukammal Legal Guidance Lein:** Aap neeche diye gaye steps parh/sun sakte hain aur mujh se mazeed sawal pooch sakte hain.

Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main ne aap ka masla samajh liya hai. Yeh **Taleem aur University ke Masail (Degree / Documents)** ke zumray mein aata hai.

- **Article 25A – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right to Education):** Har shehri ko taleem hasil karne aur apni taleemi asnaad (documents) par qanooni haq deta hai.
- **Article 4 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right of Individuals to be Dealt with in Accordance with Law):** Koi bhi idara ya university qanooni jawaz ke baghair aap ke original documents ya degree nahi rok sakti.
- **Article 18 & Article 199 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Freedom of Profession & High Court Writ Jurisdiction):** Degree ya original asnaad rokna aap ke rozgar ke haq (Art. 18) ki khilaf warzi hai aur High Court (Art. 199) mein challenge ho sakta hai.

### 📜 Laago Qanoon (Pakistani Law):
- **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Ordinance, 2002 (Section 10 (Powers and Functions of the Commission) & HEC Student Grievance Directives):** HEC Ordinance 2002 aur HEC directives ke mutabiq koi bhi university student ke original documents (Matric/Inter certificates) apne paas nahi rakh sakti aur clearance ke baad degree ya transcript rokna qanoonan mana hai.
- **Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (Article 9 (Jurisdiction, Functions and Powers)):** Sarkari university ya idaray ki taraf se degree ya documents dene mein bila-jawaz takheer 'Bad-Intizami' (Maladministration) hai jis par Wafaqi Mohtasib 60 din mein faisla karta hai.

### 🏛️ Mutaliqa Idara (Relevant Authority):
- **Higher Education Commission (HEC) – Student Grievance Portal**
- Official Portal: https://onlinehelp.hec.gov.pk
- Helpline: 051-111-119-432

HAQ-545708.replyText:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main ne aap ka masla samajh liya hai. Yeh **Sarkari Idaray, NADRA, Passport aur Bills ki Shikayat** ke zumray mein aata hai.

### ⚖️ Aap ke Qanooni aur Aaeeni Haqooq:
- **Article 4 & Article 25 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Lawful Treatment & Equality of Citizens):** Har shehri ka haq hai ke sarkari idaray qanoon ke mutabiq waqt par aur baghair kisi rishwat ya ta'assub ke kaam karein.
- **Article 19A – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right to Information):** Aap ko haq hasil hai ke aap apni darkhwast ya file ki status aur sarkari faislon ki maloomat hasil karein.

### 📜 Laago Qanoon (Pakistani Law):
- **Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (Article 9 (Maladministration by Federal Agencies)):** NADRA, Passport, Bijli/Gas companies aur tamam wafaqi idaron ki sust-rawi, ghalat billing ya na-insafi ke khilaf Wafaqi Mohtasib muft sunwai karta hai.

### 🏛️ Mutaliqa Idara (Relevant Authority):
- **Wafaqi Mohtasib (Federal Ombudsman) Secretariat**
- Official Portal: https://www.mohtasib.gov.pk
- Helpline: 1055

### ✅ Aap ke paas 2 Aasaan Options hain:
1. **Option 1 – Online Complaint Submit Karein (Edit & 1-Click Forward):** Hum ne aap ki formal complaint tayyar kar di hai. Aap usay check/edit kar ke **1-Click** mein seedha **Wafaqi Mohtasib** ko forward kar sakte hain.
2. **Option 2 – Mukammal Legal Guidance Lein:** Aap neeche diye gaye steps parh/sun sakte hain aur mujh se mazeed sawal pooch sakte hain.

Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main ne aap ka masla samajh liya hai. Yeh **Sarkari Idaray, NADRA, Passport aur Bills ki Shikayat** ke zumray mein aata hai.

### ⚖️ Aap ke Qanooni aur Aaeeni Haqooq:
- **Article 4 & Article 25 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Lawful Treatment & Equality of Citizens):** Har shehri ka haq hai ke sarkari idaray qanoon ke mutabiq waqt par aur baghair kisi rishwat ya ta'assub ke kaam karein.
- **Article 19A – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right to Information):** Aap ko haq hasil hai ke aap apni darkhwast ya file ki status aur sarkari faislon ki maloomat hasil karein.

### 📜 Laago Qanoon (Pakistani Law):
- **Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (Article 9 (Maladministration by Federal Agencies)):** NADRA, Passport, Bijli/Gas companies aur tamam wafaqi idaron ki sust-rawi, ghalat billing ya na-insafi ke khilaf Wafaqi Mohtasib muft sunwai karta hai.

### 🏛️ Mutaliqa Idara (Relevant Authority):
- **Wafaqi Mohtasib (Federal Ombudsman) Secretariat**
- Official Portal: https://www.mohtasib.gov.pk
- Helpline: 1055

### ✅ Aap ke paas 2 Aasaan Options hain:
1. **Option 1 – Online Complaint Submit Karein (Edit & 1-Click Forward):** Hum ne aap ki formal complaint tayyar kar di hai. Aap usay check/edit kar ke **1-Click** mein seedha **Wafaqi Mohtasib** ko forward kar sakte hain.
2. **Option 2 – Mukammal Legal Guidance Lein:** Aap neeche diye gaye steps parh/sun sakte hain aur mujh se mazeed sawal pooch sakte hain.

HAQ-467988.replyText:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! Main ne aap ka masla samajh liya hai. Yeh **Sarkari Idaray, NADRA, Passport aur Bills ki Shikayat** ke zumray mein aata hai.

### ⚖️ Aap ke Qanooni aur Aaeeni Haqooq:
- **Article 4 & Article 25 – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Lawful Treatment & Equality of Citizens):** Har shehri ka haq hai ke sarkari idaray qanoon ke mutabiq waqt par aur baghair kisi rishwat ya ta'assub ke kaam karein.
- **Article 19A – Constitution of Pakistan 1973 (Right to Information):** Aap ko haq hasil hai ke aap apni darkhwast ya file ki status aur sarkari faislon ki maloomat hasil karein.

### 📜 Laago Qanoon (Pakistani Law):
- **Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983 (Article 9 (Maladministration by Federal Agencies)):** NADRA, Passport, Bijli/Gas companies aur tamam wafaqi idaron ki sust-rawi, ghalat billing ya na-insafi ke khilaf Wafaqi Mohtasib muft sunwai karta hai.

### 🏛️ Mutaliqa Idara (Relevant Authority):
- **Wafaqi Mohtasib (Federal Ombudsman) Secretariat**
- Official Portal: https://www.mohtasib.gov.pk
- Helpline: 1055

### ✅ Aap ke paas 2 Aasaan Options hain:
1. **Option 1 – Online Complaint Submit Karein (Edit & 1-Click Forward):** Hum ne aap ki formal complaint tayyar kar di hai. Aap usay check/edit kar ke **1-Click** mein seedha **Wafaqi Mohtasib** ko forward kar sakte hain.
2. **Option 2 – Mukammal Legal Guidance Lein:** Aap neeche diye gaye steps parh/sun sakte hain aur mujh se mazeed sawal pooch sakte hain.
